description.en: Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers rendered live inside the DSH web GUI.
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 的 scene 壁纸实时渲染进 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI。

description.en: Render Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers live in the DSH web GUI with a self-built three.js + Rust/WASM renderer: particles, water, clouds and cloth move for real. No Wallpaper Engine runtime required; falls back through embedded MP4 / cached frame / preview so the UI never goes blank.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 里实时渲染 Wallpaper Engine 的 scene 壁纸：自研 three.js + Rust/WASM 渲染器，粒子、水波、云卷、布料真实运动。不需要 Wallpaper Engine 在后台运行；渲染失败按多级降级链回退，界面永不白屏。
